subject.title: refactor(zalouser): share offset-preserving text chunk ranges

question: Should offset-preserving range chunking become a supported public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-chunking` contract now, despite Zalouser being the only demonstrated consumer?
rationale: The patch quality does not decide whether OpenClaw should permanently support this new external API shape; that boundary choice requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep it plugin-local
options.body: Retain the proven Zalouser implementation without expanding the public SDK until a second transport establishes a genuinely shared contract.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Accept the new SDK API as permanent and land it with the current documentation, API baselines, and compatibility tests.

recommendation.title: Keep it plugin-local
recommendation.body: Retain the proven Zalouser implementation without expanding the public SDK until a second transport establishes a genuinely shared contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to this person, marked maintainer-requested, and is already routed through the protected maintainer review lane.
